## Location

Which file(s)? (e.g. `README.md`, `docs/CONTRACT.md`, `docs/SECURITY.md`,
`docs/COMPATIBILITY.md`, `docs/VERSIONING.md`)

## What's wrong or missing

Describe the inaccuracy, ambiguity, stale command/path, or gap.

## Ground truth (if known)

If you've verified the actual behavior against source (schema, fixtures, or a
downstream implementer repo), describe what you found and where. This
repository's docs are expected to be reconciled against real implementations,
not idealized — see `docs/CONTRACT.md` for the pattern of recording
discrepancies explicitly rather than silently picking a side.

## Suggested fix (optional)
